account: It is day 0, about 09:02. I came from home to town hall and read the secretary's appointment book, then returned it to its chest. Today calls for morning correspondence, a 10:00 plaza market walk, lunch at home, 13:00 town accounts, 15:00 tea at an east-bank dockside cottage, 16:30 office time, and home at 19:00. I asked the secretary about correspondence and the exact tea location but have heard no reply yet. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. The builder has walked from the plaza toward me and now stands three blocks away carrying a lantern. That may mean the builder wants to speak, but I have no evidence of their purpose. Carrying a lantern in daylight is noticeable, not proof of anything unusual. Several townsfolk have been moving near the plaza and town hall; I have not learned what brings them here. So far I have witnessed no definite problem or unusual town event.
